findings: Green chile, refrigerated, per oz: client 0.47 (King Soopers, 6.99 for 15 oz, position 15 on page 1). Private Selection green chile chicken 0.44 (6.99 for 16 oz) at King Soopers, City Market and Kroger. Santiago's 0.34 (9.49 for 28 oz) at King Soopers. Del Real chile verde 0.62 (9.99 for 16 oz) at Albertsons. We are 7 percent over private label per oz and 37 percent over Santiago's.

Green chile, shelf stable context: national median 0.37 per oz on 50 rows, private label 0.36 on 9. Hatch and Ortega cans are at all 5 banners walked, 505 Southwestern and Las Palmas at 4. That is a different aisle and it is 84 percent of what the term returns.

Queso, per oz: refrigerated national median 0.44 on 7 rows, refrigerated private label 0.46 on 3, shelf stable jars 0.28. Client queso at 6.99 for 15 oz would be 0.47, and it did not show on page 1 of 584 at King Soopers. Queso was walked at only 2 banners.
Refrigerated salsa (GROWTH) runs 0.60 per oz national median on 24 rows at Albertsons and Safeway, the richest per oz shelf in the grid. Guacamole 0.70 national, 0.59 private label, 5 rows.
Client presence: King Soopers only. City Market shows the brand in the filter but not on page 1. Absent at Kroger, Albertsons and Jewel-Osco, which is expected outside Colorado.
Named houses the grid cannot see: Queso Mama and Good and Gather have zero rows because there is no Costco, Target or Sprouts block. Santiago's shows at King Soopers only.
What changed: nothing to compare. One walk date, no prior week.

Grid: 11 blocks built out of 40 possible (8 retailers by 5 neighborhoods). Sprouts and Costco are in scope with zero blocks. No dead blocks, no blocks under 5 houses. The gap is coverage and the walker, not the routes.
Process: this matrix went active 9/12, before the Stage 0 gate existed. King Soopers, City Market and Safeway have no verified pull status in the profile, and two blocks still ride a WebFetch route.
